subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should a resolved durable wake be delivered to the current canonical session after a session reset, and which of this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 should own that contract?
rationale: The existing queue deliberately generation-fences `agentTurn` continuations but not `systemEvent` entries; choosing durable wake reset semantics and the canonical stack head is a product/state-lifecycle decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Use refreshed PR and define reset semantics
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 canonical, close this historical stack head after confirming equivalent proof, and explicitly test and document whether wake events survive session resets.

options.title: Keep this PR canonical
options.body: Close the refreshed duplicate, rebase this branch onto the selected release or main base, and add the same explicit reset-generation contract and proof here.

options.title: Pause durable wake handoff
options.body: Keep wake obligations inspection-only until maintainers choose a different owner-notification or session-lifecycle design.

recommendation.title: Use refreshed PR and define reset semantics
recommendation.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 canonical, close this historical stack head after confirming equivalent proof, and explicitly test and document whether wake events survive session resets.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current-main queue and generation-fencing behavior whose contract this feature extends.
